plugins.name: leakhound
plugins.description: Token-waste forensics: /waste, /mcp-audit, /plugin-audit, /model-audit, /trend and the /live statusline meter — causes, verdicts, and exact fixes. No hooks, no per-prompt cost.

plugins.name: leakhound-router
plugins.description: Opt-in companion: per-prompt hook that routes mechanical/search work to haiku subagents, weighted by your cost vs quality preference.

plugins.name: leakhound-guard
